sources.title: Inflammation remains a dynamic component of portal hypertension in regressive alcohol-related cirrhosis
sources.system: Mouse CCl4/TAA, male C57BL/6JRj, 12 weeks, separate sacrifice cohorts
sources.measurement: PSR CPA percentage medians and IQR; n5/6/7/7 CCl4 and n8 per TAA group
sources.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; source materials stay local
sources.limit: Same study, all values preinspected; not independent validation
sources.next: Obtain individual CPA observations and cohort identifiers
sources.validation: source review only; no clinical validation

sources.title: Turnover Rates of Hepatic Collagen and Circulating Collagen-Associated Proteins in Humans with Chronic Liver Disease
sources.system: Human mixed chronic liver disease, predominantly HCV; eight evaluated, six hepatic proteomics subjects
sources.measurement: Relative abundance; fraction new over labeling period; fractional synthesis percent/day
sources.access: Full text and supplementary Tables1/2 downloaded; three complete collagen-chain rows checked
sources.license: CC BY; keep individual published table extracts local in this iteration
sources.priority: highest for constraining synthesis, not net degradation
sources.limit: Not ALD intervention/control or paired regression; only one cirrhotic subject in study; synthesis cannot be set equal to clearance without additional assumptions
sources.next: Review labeling kinetics/pool assumptions and align units before any separate human model calibration
sources.validation: source review only; no clinical validation

sources.title: Measurement of liver collagen synthesis by heavy water labeling: effects of profibrotic toxicants and antifibrotic interventions
sources.measurement: Isotope incorporation into collagen-associated amino acids
sources.access: Publisher and PubMed text reviewed; no individual-animal dataset acquired
sources.limit: Older preclinical evidence; interventions do not supply a calibrated human drug mapping
sources.next: Seek individual labeling data with contemporaneous mass and withdrawal/control groups
sources.validation: source review only; no clinical validation

sources.title: Characterization of liver disease regression in murine models of liver fibrosis and portal hypertension
sources.system: Male C57BL/6JRj mice; 8/12 week CCl4/TAA; withdrawal1/2 weeks
sources.measurement: CPA, portal pressure and gene expression
sources.access: Full publisher text downloaded; underlying data only on reasonable request according to statement
sources.priority: close model comparator; blocked as independent data
sources.limit: Shared investigators and similar experimental design to Hofer2025; cohort overlap unresolved, not declared independent
sources.next: Request animal/cohort IDs and reuse declaration before assigning holdout status
sources.validation: source review only; no clinical validation

sources.title: Single-cell fixed RNA profiling uncovers SEMA4D and LMCD1 as therapeutic targets in a liver fibrosis model
sources.system: Mouse 10-week TAA and two-week withdrawal; human MASLD/HCV associations are separate
sources.measurement: FLEX RNA, tissue markers; VX15/2503 versus vehicle n5 per group in Figure5J
sources.access: Primary full text and GEO GSE295293 metadata acquired; archive intake recorded separately
sources.license: Article CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; do not presume same license for GEO matrices
sources.priority: highest for an experimentally distinguishable HSC/macrophage mechanism
sources.limit: Antibody experiment addresses fibrosis progression during TAA, not proven reversal of established human cirrhosis; RNA is not collagen flux
sources.next: Audit nine sample identities, pool/batch structure and author processing; pseudobulk at animal level before target analysis
sources.validation: source review only; no clinical validation

sources.title: Passively Targeted Polymeric Nanocarrier Delivering STAT1 siRNA to the Liver Ameliorates Steatohepatitis and Fibrosis in the Thioacetamide Mouse Model
sources.system: Mouse16-week TAA with four-week siSTAT1 intervention; human/murine cell experiments
sources.measurement: Reported collagen deposition, inflammation and fibrosis scores
sources.access: Publisher search text and EuropePMC abstract available; direct publisher open403; full methods/raw data not acquired
sources.limit: Abstract-level result only; quantitative parameter mapping, safety and comparison during withdrawal unverified
sources.next: Obtain full controls, group sizes, injury schedule and raw effect estimates; no numerical drug simulation yet
sources.validation: source review only; no clinical validation

sources.title: Time-course of changes in fibrous components in a thioacetamide-induced liver fibrosis model in cynomolgus monkeys
sources.system: Cynomolgus monkeys, two TAA schedules with withdrawal follow-up
sources.measurement: Fibrosis scores and collagen I/III/IV immunohistochemistry, elastic fibers
sources.access: Primary full text available; no machine-readable CPA/flux dataset acquired
sources.limit: Different species and ordinal scores; not interchangeable with mouse CPA or human collagen turnover
sources.next: Request quantitative serial collagen areas and acquisition definitions
sources.validation: source review only; no clinical validation
